application.name: Attn Invest
application.description: Jev for Investment Evaluation: versioned theses, traceable evidence, bounded Jev judgments and auditable human decisions.

capabilities.name: appport.manifest
capabilities.description: Returns the application manifest for this deployment.

definitions.description: Returns the application manifest for this deployment.

capabilities.name: appport.ping
capabilities.description: Liveness probe. Returns the server time.

definitions.description: Liveness probe. Returns the server time.

capabilities.name: attention.list

definitions.description: What needs a person across the workspace: new investment activity, proposed strategy changes, findings awaiting review, and research that is failing or stale. Each item appears once.

capabilities.name: audit.list
capabilities.description: Append-only audit history for the caller's workspace, newest first.

definitions.description: Append-only audit history for the caller's workspace, newest first.

capabilities.name: claim.pending

definitions.description: Representative claims awaiting a moderator decision, across workspaces. Challenges are not included.

capabilities.name: claim.review

definitions.description: A moderator verifies, rejects or revokes a representative claim, with a rationale and the evidence considered. Verification needs a successful domain proof or documented evidence.

capabilities.name: contribution.create

definitions.description: Records a private contribution about a firm: a correction, firsthand note, outdated-criterion flag, suggested relationship or interaction note. Private to the author's workspace until shared.

capabilities.name: contribution.edit

definitions.description: Edits a contribution by creating a new version; earlier versions stay.

capabilities.name: contribution.mine
capabilities.description: The caller's own contributions with sharing state, share history and the responses received.

definitions.description: The caller's own contributions with sharing state, share history and the responses received.

capabilities.name: contribution.queue

definitions.description: Contributions authors chose to share with moderators.

capabilities.name: contribution.respond

definitions.description: A verified representative or moderator responds to a shared contribution. A dispute is recorded beside the contribution; it never edits or deletes it.

capabilities.name: contribution.revoke

definitions.description: Revokes sharing for one audience. The receiver can no longer read it; their earlier responses remain.

capabilities.name: contribution.share

definitions.description: Shares a contribution with the firm it is about, or with moderators. Sharing is consent for that audience only; it is not publishing. Aggregate-analysis consent is a separate, explicit flag.

capabilities.name: contribution.shared
capabilities.description: Contributions authors shared with the firm. Only a verified representative of that firm can read them; authors are not identified.

definitions.description: Contributions authors shared with the firm. Only a verified representative of that firm can read them; authors are not identified.

capabilities.name: decision.record
capabilities.description: Records an investment decision. Invest requires every review gate resolved and no failed or unresolved hard gate.

definitions.description: Records an investment decision. Invest requires every review gate resolved and no failed or unresolved hard gate.

capabilities.name: directory.get
capabilities.description: A firm's published profile for a domain, or null.

definitions.description: A firm's published profile for a domain, or null.

capabilities.name: directory.list
capabilities.description: Firms that have published an investor-approved profile (current versions only). The one place a workspace reads another workspace's data, and only what a verified representative chose to publish.

definitions.description: Firms that have published an investor-approved profile (current versions only). The one place a workspace reads another workspace's data, and only what a verified representative chose to publish.

capabilities.name: document.get
capabilities.description: Ingestion status, issues, hashes and parser identity for one document.

definitions.description: Ingestion status, issues, hashes and parser identity for one document.

capabilities.name: document.link
capabilities.description: A short-lived signed link to the original file (five minutes).

definitions.description: A short-lived signed link to the original file (five minutes).

capabilities.name: document.page
capabilities.description: The extracted lines and coordinates of one page, for the source viewer.

definitions.description: The extracted lines and coordinates of one page, for the source viewer.

capabilities.description: Retention control: deletes the original file and extracted page text; evidence claims and hashes remain for audit.

definitions.description: Retention control: deletes the original file and extracted page text; evidence claims and hashes remain for audit.

definitions.description: Uploads a document (base64). Type, extension and PDF signature are checked before parsing; rejected and failed files are recorded with their reasons and no evidence.

definitions.description: Evaluation report: manifest, findings with reviewer actions applied, open diligence requests, decision history and decision blockers.

capabilities.name: evaluation.list
capabilities.description: Evaluations with status, summary and current decision.

definitions.description: Evaluations with status, summary and current decision.

capabilities.description: Creates a new evaluation linked to its predecessor. The predecessor is never modified.

definitions.description: Creates a new evaluation linked to its predecessor. The predecessor is never modified.

definitions.description: Evaluates a startup against an explicitly selected thesis version. Runs asynchronously; poll evaluation.get.

capabilities.name: evaluation.verify

definitions.description: Independently recomputes the manifest digest, projections, question digests and every policy outcome of a stored evaluation.

capabilities.name: evidence.attach
capabilities.description: Attaches evidence a reviewer verified directly, with how it was verified.

definitions.description: Attaches evidence a reviewer verified directly, with how it was verified.

definitions.description: One claim's provenance: source document, hash, page and coordinates, and cross-source verification.

capabilities.name: evidence.list
capabilities.description: Claims for a startup with provenance, derived verification and contradictions.

definitions.description: Claims for a startup with provenance, derived verification and contradictions.

capabilities.name: firm.approval.withdraw
capabilities.description: Withdraws an investor-verified criterion by appending a withdrawal; the approval stays in the history.

definitions.description: Withdraws an investor-verified criterion by appending a withdrawal; the approval stays in the history.

capabilities.name: firm.approve

definitions.description: Records an investor-verified criterion for a firm, from a research criterion or entered by hand. The only way research becomes investor-verified; requires thesis.approve.

capabilities.name: firm.get

definitions.description: One firm profile: criteria with assertion type, source passage, verification and freshness; conflicts; approved criteria; sources checked; run history; reviews.

capabilities.name: firm.list

definitions.description: Investor firm profiles in the caller's workspace, with research status, last research time and criteria counts. Optional search and status filter.

capabilities.name: firm.monitoring.set

definitions.description: Pause or resume continuous monitoring of a firm, or change its interval or crawl bounds. Pausing keeps the profile and all history.

capabilities.name: firm.reconciliation
capabilities.description: Per-field reconciliation of the firm's own statements, third-party claims, the viewer's contributions and the firm's published profile: signals, reasons and conflicts, never a score.

definitions.description: Per-field reconciliation of the firm's own statements, third-party claims, the viewer's contributions and the firm's published profile: signals, reasons and conflicts, never a score.

capabilities.description: Re-researches one existing firm in this server process within the configured crawl bounds. Accepts only a firm id, never a URL. Returns at once; poll firm.get.

definitions.description: Re-researches one existing firm in this server process within the configured crawl bounds. Accepts only a firm id, never a URL. Returns at once; poll firm.get.

capabilities.name: firm.review
capabilities.description: Flag, dispute, correct, annotate, confirm or dismiss a research criterion, an investment event or a finding. Recorded as a separate review; the research record is not changed and nothing is approved by it.

definitions.description: Flag, dispute, correct, annotate, confirm or dismiss a research criterion, an investment event or a finding. Recorded as a separate review; the research record is not changed and nothing is approved by it.

capabilities.name: firm.timeline

definitions.description: The firm's intelligence timeline: investment events, source discoveries and changes, proposed thesis changes, conflicts, failed research and reviews. Filter by type, time range and review state.

capabilities.name: firm.verify

definitions.description: Asks Jev whether each current criterion's captured passage supports its statement. Reports skipped when Jev is not configured; never simulates a result.

capabilities.name: fit.compare

definitions.description: What differs between two evaluations of the same startup and investor: inputs, then results.

capabilities.name: fit.discover

definitions.description: Candidate investors for a startup, each with mandate fit, readiness, evidence quality and research coverage kept separate. Computed on demand from the current profile; nothing is stored.

definitions.description: Evaluates one investor against the startup's current profile and evidence and records the evaluation with every input version. Identical inputs return the existing evaluation; changed inputs create a new one and never alter an earlier one.

definitions.description: A recorded evaluation with its explanation, and whether its inputs are still current.

definitions.description: Recorded evaluations for a startup, newest first, optionally for one investor.

definitions.description: What needs the caller's decision: candidate matches, unresolved conflicts, proposed claims, shared contributions, representative claims (moderators) and disputed contributions (authors).

definitions.description: Candidate matches awaiting a decision, and the history of decisions.

definitions.description: A verified representative withdraws one of their approvals by appending a withdrawal.

capabilities.name: profile.approve
capabilities.description: A verified representative approves one of the firm's criteria as the firm itself, from a research criterion, a third-party claim, or entered by hand. Works only with a verified claim for the firm's domain.

definitions.description: A verified representative approves one of the firm's criteria as the firm itself, from a research criterion, a third-party claim, or entered by hand. Works only with a verified claim for the firm's domain.

definitions.description: Checks the domain-control proof for the caller's own claim through the safe-fetch boundary. The result is evidence for the moderator, not authority.

capabilities.name: profile.claim.mine

definitions.description: The caller's representative claims with their status and history.

capabilities.name: profile.history

definitions.description: Approvals, withdrawals, publications and claim decisions for a firm, newest first.

definitions.description: Publishes exactly the chosen representative-approved criteria as a new version of the firm's public profile, readable by every workspace. Nothing is published unless chosen.

definitions.description: Withdraws the published profile by appending a withdrawal version. Earlier versions stay in the history.

definitions.description: Accept a finding, override its outcome (outcome and reason required), or comment. Findings are never edited.

definitions.description: Resolves a diligence request. A request can be resolved exactly once.

definitions.description: The authenticated principal, its workspace and permissions, and the configured Jev identity (never credentials).
